nodes.label: Extinctive Limitation of Actions in the Insurance Contract and the Fiscal Liability Process in Colombia
nodes.author: Ariza Vesga Rafael; Lizarazo Cortes Oscar Andrés

nodes.label: Conflict between Art. 1081 Commercial Code and Art. 120 Law 1474 of 2011
nodes.rationale: Proposes applying the Art. 120 limitation term in fiscal liability actions, based on the social function of contract law, to prioritize protection of the Nation's funds and assets.
